trades.name: AppLovin Corporation
trades.analysis: AppLovin (APP) is in a strong downtrend, trading below its 20-day and 200-day moving averages. The stock recently tested the $330 support level and is currently consolidating. A bounce from this support could offer a short-term trade, but the overall technical posture remains bearish.

trades.name: Red Cat Holdings, Inc.
trades.analysis: Red Cat Holdings (RCAT) is showing a strong short-term rebound with elevated relative volume, trading above its 20-day moving average. The stock recently broke above the $8.50 resistance level and is currently in a rising trend channel. A pullback and retest of this former resistance could provide an entry for a continuation of the upward momentum.

trades.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
trades.analysis: Amazon (AMZN) is in a strong, sustained uptrend, trading above all key moving averages. The stock recently pulled back to retest the $275 level, which acted as a support/pivot. A bounce from this level, maintaining the bullish momentum, could offer an entry opportunity. Relative volume is not currently elevated.

trades.name: IREN Limited
trades.analysis: IREN is in a downtrend, trading below its key short-term and long-term moving averages. The stock recently declined on heavy volume, and is currently below the 0.618 Fibonacci retracement level of $40.01, which acts as resistance. Upcoming earnings within five days present a high-risk catalyst, increasing volatility.

trades.name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.
trades.analysis: Kratos Defense (KTOS) is showing strong short-term bullish momentum, trading above its 5-day, 10-day, and 20-day moving averages. While some longer-term indicators suggest a bearish trend, the stock has recently broken out and is demonstrating positive volume balance. A pullback to previous consolidation levels could offer an entry opportunity.

trades.name: ProShares K-1 Free Crude Oil Strategy ETF
trades.analysis: ProShares K-1 Free Crude Oil Strategy ETF (OILK) is in an uptrend, trading above its 10-day, 50-day, and 200-day simple moving averages. The ETF is currently near a support level of $51.32. A bounce from this level could present an entry opportunity. Current volume is below its 3-month average.
